messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Implemented deal naming and pasted snapshot compatibility.

- Added a “Deal name” field. Names are preserved exactly, limited to 40 UTF-16 code units, and restored when loading a named snapshot. New games, restarts, size changes, and board-code loads clear the name.
- Named exports use snapshot version 2; unnamed exports remain version 1. The decoder accepts either version regardless of JSON key order and still rejects missing or unknown fields. See [snapshot.ts](/work/src/game/snapshot.ts:14) and [Reproduction.tsx](/work/src/game/controls/Reproduction.tsx:40).
- Added unit and browser coverage, and updated the [README](/work/README.md:30).

**Checks:** Type checking passed; 142 unit tests and 78 browser journeys passed, including the named-combination run. Formatting checks passed for changed files. The repository-wide format check still reports 13 untouched files under `docs/`, `scripts/`, and `tests/`.
